blocks.text:
Data from the data model is added to the view by a factory, which is a subclass of
`ListItemFactory`. There is only one such subclass in gtkmm,
`SignalListItemFactory`. Data from the model is added to the
view with signal handlers connected to a `SignalListItemFactory`.
blocks.zh: 数据模型中的数据由工厂（factory）添加到视图。工厂是 `ListItemFactory` 的子类；gtkmm 中只有这样一个子类——`SignalListItemFactory`。模型数据通过连接到 `SignalListItemFactory` 的信号处理函数添加进视图。
